description: This file defines a custom runtime exception class MiniLangRuntimeException used within the Mini-language processing framework. It extends MiniLangException and encapsulates context-related information about runtime errors occurring during Mini-language execution.

classes.name: MiniLangRuntimeException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class indicating errors during Mini-language execution, enriched with context about the affected element.

methods.name: MiniLangRuntimeException(String, MiniLangElement)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and the related MiniLangElement.

methods.name: MiniLangRuntimeException(Throwable, MiniLangElement)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a nested throwable cause and the related MiniLangElement.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Overrides the default getMessage() to append additional context about the MiniLangElement involved in the error.
